description: Type text into an element (CSS selector or aria ref) with human-like input: real per-key events, real Shift keyDown/up for capitals & symbols, variable dwell and inter-key gaps. Verifies the result against the request for input/textarea and errors on mismatch.

frameSelector.description: Optional CSS selector for an iframe. When set, selector/ref resolve inside that frame.

ref.description: aria-ref from browser_snapshot, for example e12. Provide exactly one of selector or ref.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide exactly one of selector or ref.

verify.description: Verify typed value matches request (default true) for input/textarea.

name: browser_type
